title: NormalCreative
description: Brings back the normal 1.8 creative menu to 1.21
body:
This mod brings back the normal pre 1.19.3 creative menu layout, removes modern items (by default), renames items to their original names (e.g. Terracotta to Clay), and adds numerical item ids back to their tooltips. The mod is useful when you want to play modern versions on servers based on older versions of Minecraft, especially if you're a builder and you don't want to be hit with this message every 5 seconds: ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63f291190711ec70dc5b24b6d1ca3071256703ae.png)
